_drop_band: Tier C (spec #447 table, owner call): Omega Sector is progression step 7; ordinary drops come from reqLevel 40-50, bosses from the top third of the band.
_level_scale: Tier C (spec #449 C0 first draft, untuned; game/tools/level_scale_draft.gd --step=7 --stage=omega_sector): E_sw(t) is Sleepywood's effective level at each keyframe time (9.15, 9.73, 10.80, 22.22, 36.44, 48.23, 56.85); region step 7 sets level(t) = E_sw(t) + 3 x (7 - 5) = E_sw + 6 and exp_level(t) = E_sw(t), so the character levels at Sleepywood's pace and monsters are six effective levels harder. Replaces an opening ramp (none here). C13 (#475, tier C, calibrated on training seeds 1-4): level(t) = lerp(1, E_sw(t) + 1.5, min(1, t/600)): the stage starts at effective level 1 and reaches this step's level at 10:00, because a Lv1 character cannot take Lv11-and-up damage from the first second; 1.5 levels above Sleepywood here (0.75 per step to step 12, 0.25 per step after it: the first draft's +3 per step out-ran what a band's equipment adds).
_tier: Tier A: map IDs, original_life, widths and rosters from v83 Map.wz and Mob.wz (docs/research/v83-region-maps.md). Tier C (owner, spec #449 C2 #464): region, map order, boss schedule, pool rules and weights, level_scale and boss multipliers (the first draft of game/tools/level_scale_draft.gd, untuned); the numeric curve (keyframe rate/max_alive/hp/speed, bursts, elites, exp_mult, hard_cap, post_duration_slope) copies Sleepywood exactly, and `level_scale` replaces its opening ramp. Chief Gray (Barnard Gray summons), MT-09 (a ball attack) and Zeno (melee) use their canonical attacks and skills; ordinary mobs cast no mob skills (owner, #76). Keyframes from 300 s carry no pool because map 1 picks only keyframes with t < 300 (maps 2 and 3 use their own life lists).
name: Kulan Field
_bosses: Tier C: first-draft multipliers from game/tools/level_scale_draft.gd --step=7 --stage=omega_sector (spec #449 C0), untuned; 8 s per-attack cadence as every boss. Canonical attacks, timing, stats and elements remain in Mob.wz. All bosses and reward choices must finish to clear. Chief Gray, MT-09 and Zeno are scheduled once in the whole progression (test_unique_bosses).
_maps: Tier C: owner map order and pool rules, spec #449 C2 (#464). Each boss time is relative to map entry. The natural boss maps (221040201 Barnard Field, 221030601 Defeat Monsters, 221040301 Gray's Prairie) are 2250-2414 px, so their wider field neighbours are used: 221040000 Kulan Field I (2864 px), 221030200 Boswell Field II (4214 px), 221030500 Boswell Field V (4574 px). Map 1 is a hand-written curve pool of its own life; maps 2 and 3 use their v83 life lists, which hold no timed or hidden entries, and the timed native bosses (Chief Gray 4240000, MT-09 5120100) are excluded from every pool.
